findings: 4 of5 exact-CA pool lookups returned200 and bound token metadata; Robinhood sample lookup was429, not unsupported/absent.
BSC MEME and MISU use64hex V4 pool IDs; pool identifiers must be provider opaque identifiers, not20-byte token-address regex.
POLLY spans a migration: current pool began2026-11-09T17:40:06Z while historical window begins16:59Z; old pool began17:02:06Z. Missing pre-pool bars cannot be called no-trade.
Pool metadata alone does not establish historical OHLCV completeness. No OHLCV response has yet been fetched.
GeckoTerminal docs define empty intervals as no swaps in that indexed pool. This does not prove a GMGN missing minute had no trades, particularly when GMGN raw response does not bind a pool.
Never use another chain or same-symbol CEX/stock data. BSC and Robinhood MEME share an address string and must remain distinct identities.
requiredBinding: Whitelist exact network from networks registry; sol maps tosolana only.
Bind token CA through network-prefixed relationship AND included token address/decimals; preserve case onSolana.
Select and record one pool/dex per entire window; never splice providers or pools to fill gaps.
Request token=exactCA,currency=usd,minute aggregate1; do not rescale already-normalized USD prices by token decimals.
Preserve source request/receive clocks and fixed historical or current boundaries. Reject partial/future, duplicate, malformed, nonaligned bars.
include_empty_intervals=false for actual market observations. Filled zero-volume bars remain separate diagnostic evidence and cannot count toward current strategy continuity/admission.
